decision.title: Fuzz targets (packet )
decision.summary: Five libFuzzer targets under tests/fuzz/ check crashes, leaks, invalid-argument returns, invariants and timeouts, built by the fuzz preset and run by tools/fuzz.sh with seeds from tools/fuzz-seeds.py.

item.p: Targets. Every tests/fuzz/<name>_fuzz.c is a libFuzzer executable (glob, ) linked with tests/fuzz/fuzz_fixture.c: xml_parse_fuzz (parse into an arena tree and read every node back; check must give the same status), xpath_compile_fuzz (both front ends, then sxml_xpath_compile against the whole function library), xpath_evaluate_fuzz (compile and evaluate with a parsed context document and small limits; the internal evaluator until 1.23's processor), regex_fuzz (flags byte, regex, NUL, input; every disjoint match and its groups) and cast_fuzz (target byte, text; the canonical text of an atomic result must cast back to the same canonical text).

What a finding is. A crash or sanitizer report; a leak (the counting allocator's blocks and the item heap's cells are checked after every input, on a fixture made fresh per input); an entry point returning INVALID_ARGUMENT, INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY, MISALIGNED_MEMORY or INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE for arguments the target made valid (an error in sxml: for compilation, the verifier or the function table); a broken invariant above; a timeout (10 s per input). Deep input is not bounded in the targets: it must cost heap, not C stack ().
Build. Preset fuzz: Clang, RelWithDebInfo, ASan and UBSan, the library built with -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link, no apps/. ctest --preset fuzz runs each target on 2000 generated inputs.

Running. tools/fuzz.sh --seconds N runs every target at once for N seconds in a kept work directory; seeds come from tools/fuzz-seeds.py (xmlconf and QT4 documents, QT4 queries, the literal arguments of fn:matches-like calls and xs:T("...") constructors; at most 4000 per target), never committed (); the first run merges them into a corpus. The script fails on any artifact, except timeouts of xpath_evaluate_fuzz, which runs in fork mode and lists them for triage until the evaluator has a step limit (P9).

CI. Running each target for 60 s in CI is a ci.yml change, owned by 1.27: a Linux job cmake --preset fuzz && cmake --build --preset fuzz && tools/fuzz.sh --no-build --build-directory build/fuzz --seconds 60.
